metrics.investment_case_interpretation: 按折后可持续可分配现金利润人民币3000万元计算，当前市值/折后现金利润约13.8年，符合profit_cheap入门标准；同时折后可剥离净资金已覆盖粗筛市值，但该覆盖依赖内地现金可上翻和关联方贷款回收的折扣假设。

cash_breakdown.item: RMB cash after excluding IPO strategic reserve and operating cash reserve
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Cash is mainly in Mainland China subsidiaries and the annual report does not prove parent-level or quick offshore dividend access; use the upper-middle end of the Mainland subsidiary default range because there are no borrowings or pledged assets.
cash_breakdown.reason: RMB cash disclosed was RMB1,197.932m; deduct HKD555.2m unused IPO proceeds converted at 0.9057 and RMB190m operating cash reserve before applying haircut.
cash_breakdown.source: Annual Report 2025 MD&A cash currency table, note 21, Use of Net Proceeds table

cash_breakdown.item: Time deposits with original maturity over three months
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Terms range from six months to three years, so use long-dated time-deposit conservative range.
cash_breakdown.reason: Non-pledged time deposits are not operating assets but maturity is not all short term.

cash_breakdown.item: USD cash and bank balances, RMB equivalent
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: USD cash is not RMB-restricted by denomination, but the annual report does not split legal entity ownership; use ordinary subsidiary cash haircut.
cash_breakdown.reason: Cash denomination table discloses USD balances in RMB equivalent.
cash_breakdown.source: Annual Report 2025 MD&A cash currency table

cash_breakdown.item: HKD cash and bank balances, RMB equivalent
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: HKD cash is small and likely accessible through Hong Kong/offshore accounts, but entity split is still not disclosed.
cash_breakdown.reason: Cash denomination table discloses HKD balances in RMB equivalent.
cash_breakdown.source: Annual Report 2025 MD&A cash currency table

cash_breakdown.item: Amount due from China SCE Group, non-trade related
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: This is a secured related-party loan due within twelve months, but borrower concentration and controlling-shareholder property exposure make recoverability uncertain; treat as a heavily discounted detachable financial asset rather than cash.
cash_breakdown.reason: Loan is secured, fixed interest at 5.5%, repayable within twelve months, net of RMB3.007m impairment allowance.

cash_breakdown.item: Unused IPO proceeds reserved for strategic acquisitions and investments
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Disclosed board-approved use remains strategic acquisitions/investments by 31 December 2027, so it is not treated as freely detachable cash.
cash_breakdown.reason: HKD555.2m converted to RMB using 2025-12-31 HKD/CNY reference rate 0.9057.
cash_breakdown.source: Annual Report 2025 Use of Net Proceeds table; HKD/CNY 2025-12-31 reference rate

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Reserve roughly two months of cash operating cost for a Mainland property-management platform with contract liabilities and working-capital swings.
cash_breakdown.reason: 2025 cost of sales plus selling and administrative expenses were about RMB1.140bn before depreciation adjustment; two months is about RMB190m.
cash_breakdown.source: Annual Report 2025 income statement and cash flow working-capital movements

cash_breakdown.item: Tax, FX and dividend friction reserve
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Additional reserve for PRC-to-offshore dividend, tax, foreign-exchange and execution friction after cash haircut.
cash_breakdown.reason: Applied as a direct deduction from discounted detachable assets.
cash_breakdown.source: Annual Report 2025 note 21 RMB convertibility disclosure and note 10 tax jurisdiction disclosure

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: No bank borrowings and no assets pledged or restricted for borrowings.
cash_breakdown.reason: No financing debt to deduct other than ordinary operating leases, which are reflected in profit/cash quality rather than cash debt deduction.
cash_breakdown.source: Annual Report 2025 MD&A Borrowings and Pledge of Assets

profit_quality.assessment: The current operating business is profitable but much smaller than 2023 headline profit. A sustainable distributable cash-profit base of RMB40m is used, based on 2024-2025 core operating profit after excluding interest income tied to detachable cash and the related-party loan, then applying a 0.75 cash-profit haircut.
adjustments: Excluded interest income of RMB45.376m in 2025 because the underlying cash/related-party loan principal is treated as detachable in the net-cash calculation.
De-emphasized 2023 parent profit of RMB257.048m because 2023 included a much higher profit level and non-recurring bargain-purchase gain in the cash-flow reconciliation.

Used 2024-2025 core operating profit before interest as the anchor: 2025 gross profit less selling and administrative expenses was about RMB53.047m before tax; 2024 comparable amount was about RMB50.654m.
Deducted current tax economics and maintenance capex; operating cash flow was positive, but receivable impairments and reliance on Mainland property-management customers keep the haircut below 1.0.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: Operating cash flow was RMB146.504m/RMB277.119m/RMB215.413m for 2025/2024/2023 and annual capex was only RMB16.918m/RMB15.148m/RMB17.799m, but OCF includes interest receipts from funds assets.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Cash conversion is positive, but property-management receivable impairments, reliance on Mainland related-party ecosystem, and excluded interest income require a 25% haircut.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Reported OCF/parent profit is strong for 2024-2025, but headline OCF is inflated by interest received.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Recent capex is stable around RMB15m-18m per year and low versus revenue.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: Receivables and contract liabilities move materially year to year; 2025 trade receivables still required impairment losses of RMB71.652m.

limitations: Cash is not split by parent company, Hong Kong/offshore entity and Mainland subsidiaries; Mainland RMB cash was therefore discounted rather than fully deducted.
The RMB value of unused HKD IPO proceeds uses a reference HKD/CNY exchange rate rather than a company-disclosed conversion.
The related-party loan is secured and current but collateral detail and post-year-end repayment were not verified; it was heavily haircut to 25%.
